execution_isolation.evidence_quote: The sandbox subsystem enforces filesystem and network
execution_isolation.note: Evidence is a third-party paper describing a Python port of Codex CLI, not the pinned Rust repo. It describes platform-native OS sandboxing of host processes: Seatbelt on macOS, Bubblewrap/Landlock/seccomp on Linux, and restricted tokens on Windows. The default sandbox mode is read-only. This OS-level sandboxing of host subprocesses does not fit the value list well; 'subprocess' is the closest value, though Bubblewrap uses namespaces. This is an ambiguity case. The pinned repo's default deployment code was not in the excerpts.
